goal: 20 more v2 high-quality One Life Relay stages (batch B)

stages.title: 호박 압착
stages.description: 송진을 눌러 호박으로 굳히되 금이 가지 않게 하세요.
stages.mechanic: Workshop press. Hold to increase pressure on glowing sap. Release to rest. Fill a meter without crossing crack threshold. Camera close on the press plates.

stages.title: 물레방아
stages.description: 물레방아 통이 물줄기를 받는 순간에 곡식을 넣으세요.
stages.mechanic: Watermill side view 3D. Buckets rotate. Drop grain only when a bucket is under the chute. Distinct from tide-bell. Camera on the wheel and hopper.

stages.title: 수정 풍경
stages.description: 빛나는 수정을 순서대로 쳐 풍경을 울리세요.
stages.mechanic: Cave of hanging crystals. One glows as the next note. Strike only the glowing one. Distinct from harp-gale (no wind strings). Camera looking up into the chandelier.

stages.title: 용암석 징검
stages.description: 식는 징검돌을 밟아 칼데라를 건너세요.
stages.failCondition: 용암에 빠지거나 식은 돌이 깨지면 실패
stages.mechanic: Stones rise from magma, glow then cool and crumble. Jump while gold-hot. Distinct from ember-raft (no raft). Camera behind across the caldera.

stages.title: 구름 양떼
stages.description: 그물로 구름 양을 떠 우리에 넣으세요.
stages.mechanic: Sky meadow. Fluffy sheep-clouds drift. Storm clouds are dark. Scoop with a net then dump into a floating pen. Distinct from comet-net. Camera in the clouds.

stages.title: 시계 바늘
stages.description: 거대한 시계 바늘을 타고 12시에 뛰어내리세요.
stages.mechanic: Inside a clock face. Ride the minute hand. Jump to the hour hand then to the XII bell. Distinct from pendulum-spire (no rappel). Camera on the face.

stages.title: 얼음 피리
stages.description: 바람이 부는 구멍을 손가락으로 막아 음을 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: Giant ice flute. Wind cycles through holes. Cover the indicated hole. Wrong cover cracks ice. Close-up camera along the flute.

stages.title: 쇠똥구리
stages.description: 구슬을 언덕 위로 굴려 둥지에 넣으세요.
stages.mechanic: Beetle pushing a sphere up a dune. Drag to shove. Gravity pulls back. Distinct from atlas-sphere (ruins marble, downhill). Camera behind the beetle.

stages.title: 진주 숨
stages.description: 숨을 참고 진주를 집어 수면으로 돌아오세요.
stages.mechanic: Oyster bed. Breath meter drains underwater, refills at surface. Grab pearls then surface. Distinct from reef-sub and kelp-gate. Follow camera.

stages.title: 풍차 날개
stages.description: 날개 각도를 바람과 맞춰 곡식을 제분하세요.
stages.mechanic: Dutch mill. Wind direction shifts. Set blade pitch to catch it. Too steep snaps. Distinct from frost-skiff sailing. Camera on the mill and vanes.

stages.title: 송진 받기
stages.description: 떨어지는 송진을 틀에 받아 촛대를 만드세요.
stages.mechanic: Pine sap drips from cuts. Move a candle mold under drips. Distinct from tessera-fall. Close workshop camera.

stages.title: 까마귀 우편
stages.description: 날아가는 까마귀에게 서찰을 던져 넣으세요.
stages.mechanic: Keep tower. Ravens fly past. Lead-toss letters into saddlebags. Distinct from aurora-harpoon (no serpents). Camera from the parapet.

stages.title: 소금 결정
stages.description: 염수를 떨어뜨려 결정을 키우되 녹이지 마세요.
stages.mechanic: Salt pan close-up. Drip brine onto a seed crystal. Too fast melts it. Distinct from ice-core-drill. Macro camera.

stages.title: 매 급강하
stages.description: 급강하로 토끼를 잡고 지면 직전에 끌어올리세요.
stages.mechanic: Hold to stoop, release to pull up. Catch rabbits in the dive window. Distinct from owl-silent (no stealth moonlight). Camera behind falcon.

stages.title: 우물 두레박
stages.description: 두레박을 벽에 안 닿게 내려 물을 퍼 올리세요.
stages.mechanic: Looking down a stone well. Lower a bucket, sway from rope. Distinct from kraken-well (no tentacles). Top-down 3D well.

stages.title: 봉화
stages.description: 연기를 막았다 열어 봉화 신호를 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: Mountain beacon. A pattern of long/short puffs is shown. Cover the fire to cut smoke. Distinct from morse-lighthouse. Camera on the pyre and valley.

stages.title: 연잎 도약
stages.description: 가라앉기 전에 연잎을 건너 연못 사당까지 가세요.
stages.mechanic: Lily pads sink after landing. Jump onward quickly. Distinct from ice-floe-hop if similar - this is sinking pads not sliding ice. Camera behind across the pond.

stages.title: 불씨 길
stages.description: 식어가는 불씨를 밟아 화로 끝까지 건너세요.
stages.mechanic: Path of cooling coals. Too hot burns, too cold crumbles to ash. Walk the gold band. Distinct from magma-skip (horizontal coal path not caldera hops). Camera behind.

stages.title: 나선 계단
stages.description: 돌아가는 나선 계단을 타이밍에 맞춰 오르세요.
stages.mechanic: Helical staircase rotates. Jump onto incoming steps. Distinct from hourglass-climb. Camera inside the tower looking up the helix.

stages.title: 등불 물길
stages.description: 떠가는 등불이 부딪히지 않게 물길을 여세요.
stages.mechanic: Festival canal. Lanterns float. Open/close gates to route them. Collision extinguishes. Distinct from koi-gate (lanterns not fish) and canal-lock (no barge levels). Top-down 3D canal.
